content: GlobalShortcuts portal: CreateSession(IN options a{sv}, OUT handle o); BindShortcuts(IN session_handle o, IN shortcuts a(sa{sv}), IN parent_window s, IN options a{sv}, OUT request_handle o); ListShortcuts(IN session_handle o, IN options a{sv}, OUT request_handle o). Signals: Activated(o,s,t,a{sv}), Deactivated(o,s,t,a{sv}), ShortcutsChanged(o session_handle, a(sa{sv}) shortcuts). Request-side shortcut vardict keys: description(s), preferred_trigger(s). Response/ListShortcuts/ShortcutsChanged shortcut vardict keys: description(s), trigger_description(s) — 'User-readable text describing how to trigger the shortcut for the client to render'. NO machine-readable combination is returned anywhere. 'An application can only attempt to bind shortcuts of a session once.' Doc states no ordering between BindShortcuts Response and ShortcutsChanged.
